messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.25-15
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl (1.25-15) has been released at its web site (http://www.rqtl.org) and on CRAN.

There are no major changes, but there are a number of important bug fixes.  See http://www.rqtl.org/STATUS.txt for a complete list of changes.

Karl Broman
kbr...@biostat.wisc.edu
